SmartClean 1.0.1 — bug-fix release.

- Trash GUI page count now follows the configured `trash.maxPages`, so pages 2..8 are really reachable instead of always showing 1 / 1.
- Page arrows moved into a transparent side gutter of the widened container screen; JEI no longer covers them or swallows the clicks.
- The page-arrow texture is sampled with its real 28x96 size (Forge 1.20.1 previously sampled the wrong region and drew black blocks).
- Clicking a trash slot behaves like vanilla grabbing: the item follows the cursor and you place it yourself; leftovers are put back when the inventory is full, and a carried stack is returned to the inventory on close instead of dropping.
- Fixed a client/server page mismatch where the client kept rendering the first page while the server took items from another page, which made items disappear on click.
- The client-side trash view is now read-only, so local click prediction can no longer consume the shared trash store before the server takes the item.
- Configuration moved from `serverconfig` to `config/smartclean-common.toml`; new `trash.playerInsert` (default false) lets players put items into the trash themselves.
- Removed the per-slot countdown text from the trash GUI.

---
SmartClean 1.0.1 修复版。

- 回收站页数改为跟随配置 `trash.maxPages`，第 2～8 页现在真的能翻到，不再永远显示 1 / 1。
- 翻页箭头移入界面加宽后的透明侧边带，JEI 不再覆盖它、也不会抢走点击。
- 翻页贴图按真实的 28x96 尺寸采样（Forge 1.20.1 之前采样到错误区域，显示成黑块）。
- 点击回收站槽位恢复原版抓取语义：物品跟到光标、由玩家自己放进背包；背包放不下时原样退回，关界面时光标上的物品收回背包而不是掉落。
- 修复客户端与服务端页码错位：客户端仍在渲染第一页时服务端已经从另一页取物，导致点击后物品消失。
- 客户端回收站视图改为只读，本地点击预测不再提前消耗与服务端共享的回收站存储。
- 配置从 serverconfig 移到 `config/smartclean-common.toml`；新增 `trash.playerInsert`（默认 false），打开后玩家可自行把物品放进回收站。
- 移除回收站槽位上的倒计时文字显示。
